MGM+ Announces Four-Part Documentary Series 'New Wave' Detailing Music Evolution from 1977 to 1987

Exploring the New Wave Music Revolution

MGM has announced the upcoming release of a new four-part documentary series titled *New Wave*, which charts the transformation of the alternative music landscape from 1977 through 1987. According to the initial announcements, the project explores how the genre embraced new technology, women, and the queer community to bring alternative culture into the mainstream.

The documentary is directed by filmmaker Douglas Tirola and produced by This Machine Filmworks in association with 4th Row Films and Polygram Entertainment.

Cast and Featured Artists

While structured as a documentary rather than a traditional narrative film, the series features appearances and archival contributions from several prominent music legends of the era. Confirmed participants mentioned in the promotional materials include:

  • Billy Idol
  • The Police
  • DEVO
  • Duran Duran
  • Oingo Boingo

Release Information and Distribution

  • Original Language: English
  • Format: Four-part documentary series
  • Platform: Streaming exclusively on MGM+
  • Confirmed Release Date: November 23, 2026
  • Release-Date Uncertainty: While MGM has slated the premiere for late November 2026, streaming schedules remain subject to platform adjustments prior to the official debut.

How to Verify

Viewers interested in tracking updates or viewing promotional materials can access the official mini-trailer and poster directly through the MGM+ streaming service channels or via the official YouTube platform uploads provided by distributors. Additional announcements regarding regional availability outside the initial MGM+ rollout have not yet been specified.
